title: Strange deaths of abduction researchers, two John Macks hit by cars

tellings.quote: And if I recall, another guy named John Mack was hit by a car in the same day, right in in England.

plain: The abduction researcher John Mack, who studied people saying they were taken by beings, was killed by a car in England, and on the same day another man named John Mack was also hit by a car there. Tim Alberino tells Michels this from memory ('if I recall'), placing it among the deaths of other abduction researchers he lists, Karla Turner, Budd Hopkins and Barbara Bartholic. If true, the coincidence would hint that someone was targeting people who looked into abductions.
